---
title: "Usage of Large Database Renewals"
author: "Alexander Harriman"
date: "2026-02-19"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


This file takes title lists for all databases that are up for Spring 2026 renewals and finds their respective titles in the Master TR database to get their total Unique Item Requests for the last three years.

The title lists will come from each vendor's website, with sources marked with the files. All close matches will be found with fuzzy matching, where all matches that clear a certain threshold will be included.


```{r, warning = FALSE}
reticulate::py_config()
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(fuzzywuzzyR)
library(RSQLite)
library(DBI)
library(readr)
library(reticulate)
difflib <- import("difflib")
```

proQuestTitle

# Fuzzy Match the Database Titles to the Full Title List


```{r}
relevantTitleList <- c()

 for(i in 1:dim(musicPeriodical)[1]){
   if(i %% 200 == 0){
    print(i)
   }

   titleName <- musicPeriodical$Title[i]

   matchTest <- difflib$get_close_matches(titleName, proQuestTitle$Title, n = 3L, cutoff = 0.95)

   for(j in length(matchTest)){
     relevantTitleList <- append(relevantTitleList, matchTest[j])
   }

 }

relevantUsage <- proQuestTitle |>
  filter(Title %in% relevantTitleList)

relevantUsage

sum(relevantUsage$Last_3_Years_Usage)
```

   for(j in length(matchTest)){

# Fuzzy Match the Database Titles to the Full Title List


```{r}
relevantTitleList <- c()

   for(j in length(matchTest)){

   }

 }

relevantUsage <- ebscoTitle |>
  filter(Title %in% relevantTitleList)

relevantUsage

```

# Fuzzy Match the Database Titles to the Full Title List


```{r}

   }

 }

relevantUsage <- ebscoTitle |>
  filter(Title %in% relevantTitleList)

relevantUsage

sum(relevantUsage$Last_3_Years_Usage)
```

# Fuzzy Match the Database Titles to the Full Title List


```{r}
relevantTitleList <- c()

 for(i in 1:dim(lisSource)[1]){
   if(i %% 100 == 0){
      print(i)
   }

   titleName <- lisSource$`Publication Name`[i]

   matchTest <- difflib$get_close_matches(titleName, ebscoTitle$Title, n = 3L, cutoff = 0.95)


   for(j in length(matchTest)){
     relevantTitleList <- append(relevantTitleList, matchTest[j])
   }

 }

relevantUsage <- ebscoTitle |>
  filter(Title %in% relevantTitleList)

relevantUsage

sum(relevantUsage$Last_3_Years_Usage)
```

# Fuzzy Match the Database Titles to the Full Title List


```{r}
relevantTitleList <- c()

 for(i in 1:dim(lisa)[1]){
   if(i %% 100 == 0){
    print(i)
   }

   titleName <- lisa$`Serial Title`[i]

   matchTest <- difflib$get_close_matches(titleName, proQuestTitle$Title, n = 3L, cutoff = 0.95)

   for(j in length(matchTest)){
     relevantTitleList <- append(relevantTitleList, matchTest[j])
   }

 }

relevantUsage <- proQuestTitle |>
  filter(Title %in% relevantTitleList)

relevantUsage

sum(relevantUsage$Last_3_Years_Usage)
```
